verdict.rationale: Automation is a fair question for an IP-office e-services portal, since such offices can publish APIs or bulk-data feeds, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows interactive web services: e-filing, public search, status tracking and downloadable forms. Nothing documents an API, CLI, or headless/CI-friendly interface, and the llms.txt probe returned 404. Scraping the public status search would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.
